concept: The moment a conversation moves between an assistant and a person: the offer and why, the wait, who has taken over, and the hand back.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a human handoff as a red alert banner that says Escalated
default_to_avoid.kind: human handoff, escalation, live agent transfer, talk to a person
default_to_avoid.why_not: a red alert frightens the reader and says nothing about who or how long; Pane says who, why and the wait in words in a quiet row

derivation.consequence: opaque pairs are computed, glass pairs are measured
derivation.form: the row is quiet and centred like a divider in the conversation

derivation.consequence: one solid fill exists, the loud solid (white in dark, ink in light); a promoted action is the same solid glowing with its own light, and a pane uses one of them
derivation.form: the offer has one loud action, Talk to a person, and a ghost Not now

derivation.consequence: labels and names exist for assistive tech even when hidden visually
derivation.form: each change is one sentence that names who

options: A quiet row that names who
C a system message line only
variants.picked: A quiet row that names who
variants.reason: A keeps calm and names the person and the wait (P2, P6). B alarms. C gives the reader no way to accept or decline.

root.why: a quiet tinted row centred in the conversation, with its edge

line.why: the glyph or avatar and the words share one row

glyph.why: a person glyph, or a turning arc while connecting

turning.why: while connecting the arc turns slowly, so the reader sees the wait is live

avatar.why: once connected, the person's avatar replaces the glyph

text.why: the words align to the start beside the glyph

title.why: one medium-weight sentence names who is coming and what happens

meta.why: the reason or the wait is label size in the secondary tone

actions.why: at most one loud action and a ghost one, centred under the line

@media prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.why: under reduced motion nothing turns, blinks or breathes, and the word carries the news

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the system draws the edges and marks, so every part stays findable

@turn.why: the connecting arc turns once a second or so
